reference: Main women Michael dates on screen: Jan Levinson (on and off S2-S4), Carol Stills (realtor, S2E22-S3E10), Holly Flax (S4E14/S5, then S7; engaged S7E18), Helene Beesly (Pam's mother, S6E6-S6E8), and Donna Newton (Sid & Dexter's manager, S6E21-S6E23, turns out to be married). Minor/one-off: concierge Marie (one night in Winnipeg, S5E7) and unnamed set-up dates (S4E10-11). Sex Ed (S7E4) confirms the core five: he contacts Donna, Holly, Jan, Helene and Carol as ex-lovers.

Michael: [standing outside hotel room... whispering] Do you want to get some breakfast or something? Concierge Marie: I am so tired.

list_items.item: Jan Levinson (boss; hook-up S2E16, relationship S3-S4, they live together; over by Chair Model S4E10, where he is dating again)
Carol Stills (realtor; first date Casino Night, dumps him at Christmas)
Holly Flax (HR; dates S5 until transfer, again S7, proposes S7E18)
Donna Newton (manager of Sid & Dexter's; affair, she is married)
Minor: concierge Marie (one night on the Winnipeg business trip)
Minor: unnamed set-up dates after Jan breakup
Julie, Pam's friend, a set-up date at the Happy Hour (Michael as 'Date Mike')
Margaret, a set-up blind date at the coffee shop

caveats: The five main items are certain. Minor items are a judgment call: Marie is a one-night hook-up, not dating; set-up dates are unnamed. Do not count: 'Tara' (S7E11 sc.47, a girlfriend Michael claims to make Holly jealous; Dwight doubts she exists), the 'European girlfriend' at Niagara (S6E4 sc.56, implied invention), the dead chair model (S4E10), or Julie (S2E19, a date that never happened). Benihana waitresses (S3E10) are a brief rebound outing; mentioning them is fine but not required. An answer listing the five main women is complete; the order of Jan's on/off phases is not required. Added after the pilot grading: Julie (Happy Hour) and Margaret (Chair Model) are real set-up dates, optional items; the S2E19 Julie date never happened.
